verdict.rationale: Mastra is an agent framework and platform with a server and Mastra Cloud deployment, so issuing scoped, least-privilege credentials for agents is a fair axis. The evidence pack never mentions API keys, credential issuance, or per-agent permission scoping. Guardrails for input and output processing and per-agent tool assignment are adjacent controls, not scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
